name: com.enercast/enercast
title: Enercast
description: US natural gas pipeline notices, daily supply and demand, capacity offline and new projects.

tools.name: get_critical_notices
tools.description: Current critical notices (force majeure, unplanned outages, maintenance, OFOs, capacity restrictions and their lifts) posted by US interstate natural gas pipelines, as scored by Enercast: severity 1-5, event type, bullish/bearish direction, Bcf/d impact, dates, a short summary and a link to the notice on enercast.com. Free: what enercast.com/notices/ shows, last 7 days, held back 60 minutes.

pipeline.description: Pipeline name or part of it, e.g. "Transco", "Tennessee", "EPNG"

event_type.description: e.g. force_majeure, maintenance, outage, ofo, lift

since.description: ISO date/time; notices updated since then

sort.description: newest = most recently updated first (default); severity = highest severity first

tools.name: get_daily_supply_demand
tools.description: Enercast's daily US natural gas supply and demand totals in Bcf/d for 8 categories (supply/production, LNG feedgas, Canada imports, Mexico exports, LDC citygate, industrial end use, power generation, net storage) from pipeline scheduled quantities, with day-over-day change; plus LNG Canada (modeled estimate). Latest published gas day and up to 30 prior days, as on enercast.com/daily-summary/.

category.description: One category only (default: all 8). end_user = industrial end use; storage = net storage

tools.name: get_capacity_offline
tools.description: Enercast's Capacity Offline ledger: Bcf/d of US interstate pipeline capacity offline from outages and maintenance, by event (pipeline, facility, dates, reduction), as on enercast.com/calendar/.

pipeline.description: Pipeline or facility name, or part of it, e.g. "Transco", "Gillis"

state.description: Event state to show (default: active and scheduled together)

tools.name: get_new_projects
tools.description: Enercast's trackers of new US natural gas pipeline, storage and LNG export projects: status (announced to in service), stated capacity, stated in-service timing, sponsor and states, with a link to each project page. Capacities are as stated by the source.

tracker.description: pipelines = New Pipelines (/new-capacity/), storage = New Storage, lng_export = New LNG Export

status.description: e.g. Under construction, Approved, In service

query.description: Part of a project or sponsor name

since.description: Projects changed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: The US interstate natural gas pipelines whose critical notices Enercast monitors, with active notice counts, highest active severity and each pipeline's enercast.com page.

query.description: Pipeline name or part of it, e.g. "Tennessee" (default: all)

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: When each Enercast dataset behind these tools was last published, and the update cadence.

tools.name: get_notice_history
tools.description: Subscribers (Enercast Institutional or notices plan; sign in or send an API key): the full archive of scored pipeline notices up to 366 days back, with notice text.

pipeline.description: Pipeline name or part of it, e.g. "Transco"

query.description: Words in the notice title, e.g. "force majeure"

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the 30 days ending at to; at most 366 days per call)

tools.name: get_flow_history
tools.description: Enercast Institutional: daily category or component (e.g. LNG terminal, Canada crossing) totals in Bcf/d, up to 366 days, from pipeline scheduled quantities.

level.description: category = the 8 national totals (default); component = their parts, e.g. each LNG terminal, Canada imports vs exports, supply basins

component.description: Component name or part of it, e.g. "Sabine Pass", "Imports from Canada", "Appalachia" (level=component)

from.description: First gas day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the 31 days ending at to; at most 366 days per call)

to.description: Last gas day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, UTC)

tools.name: get_project_changes
tools.description: Enercast Institutional: the daily change log or dated milestones of the New Pipelines and New Storage trackers, with sources.

tracker.description: pipelines = New Pipelines tracker, storage = New Storage tracker

view.description: changes = the daily change log (default); milestones = dated project milestones

project.description: Project name or part of it

since.description: Only rows on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (change date or milestone date)
